description: Implement the Tasks microservice as a Node.js Express app wrapped for AWS Lambda. Includes full CRUD REST API, DynamoDB integration, userId reference for task ownership, and package.json.
steps: Create services/tasks/package.json with same dependencies as users service: express, @vendia/serverless-express, @aws-sdk/client-dynamodb, @aws-sdk/lib-dynamodb

Create services/tasks/app.js - Express app with routes: GET /tasks, GET /tasks/:id, POST /tasks, PUT /tasks/:id, DELETE /tasks/:id. Task schema: { id (uuid), title, description, status (enum: 'pending'|'in_progress'|'done'), userId, createdAt }. Table name from env var TASKS_TABLE.
Add GET /tasks?userId=xxx query param support to filter tasks by userId.
Create services/tasks/handler.js - Lambda entry point wrapping app.js with @vendia/serverless-express.
Return proper HTTP status codes matching the users service conventions. Validate required fields: title and userId on POST.
acceptance_criteria: services/tasks/package.json exists with all required dependencies
services/tasks/app.js exports an Express app with all 5 CRUD routes plus userId filter on GET /tasks
Task schema includes userId field linking to a user
No placeholder TODOs remain in core logic
verification: Read services/tasks/handler.js and confirm Lambda handler export
Read services/tasks/app.js and confirm all routes including userId filter are implemented
